channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about South Sudan | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about South Sudan from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Bol Bol, South Sudan
item.description:
Durant has been so moved by representing Team USA that he has encouraged other players to take advantage of the Olympic experience whenever it presents itself.

“Bol Bol had the chance to play for South Sudan, and I was encouraging him to do so,”

Kevin Durant on Bol Bol, South Sudan, Sep 11, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Royal Ivey on South Sudan
item.description:
head coach Royal Ivey said.

“We’re bringing them together. We’re uniting the fans and the people of South Sudan. And that’s way bigger than wins and losses.”

Royal Ivey on South Sudan, Aug 1, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on South Sudan
item.description:
“Just think about it, that team got to start really competing in 2017. That’s not that long ago. And then obviously the history around South Sudan is just incredible,”

Bam Adebayo on South Sudan, Jul 31, 2024. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Royal Ivey on South Sudan
item.description:
“At the end of the day, that's all brotherly love, and I love that dude. And you know, the feeling is mutual. So, you know, he said something to me. I'm a competitor. I'm a jerk back.”

Royal Ivey on South Sudan, Jul 31, 2024. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Royal Ivey on South Sudan
item.description:
Ivey recalled the situation.

“They were fouling, and he got fouled, and he was like, 'Play basketball!' And I'm like, 'How are we supposed to play basketball? You are all playing touch like it's football.' So, we exchanged a couple of words, and I moved on,”

Royal Ivey on South Sudan, Jul 31, 2024. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Steve Kerr on South Sudan
item.description:
“So it's got to be 40 minutes of force and attention and focus, and we can't let teams outplay us effort- and energy-wise like we did the other night against Germany, like we did against South Sudan.”

Steve Kerr on South Sudan, Jul 25, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Royal Ivey, South Sudan
item.description:
“And even better news is our assistant coach Royal Ivey, South Sudan. Are you kidding me? Qualified. He put in the work, great team behind him,”

Jacque Vaughn on Royal Ivey, South Sudan, Feb 26, 2023. Source: New York Post.
